name: H -HARD CORE-
source:
The protagonist is a young woman who, despite her many fetishes and love of masturbation, has never been with a man before.

One day while at work, she steals some money from the cash register she's stationed at. Although she thinks nobody saw, her boss was onto her the whole time...

Angry with her for doing such a thing, her boss nearly calls the police on her, before realizing he had another option. The protagonist can sell her body to him to pay back what she did, as well as earn a higher salary than before.
